distant_fair_generator.purpose: fair positional one-shot when player within 10 tiles of (39.3, 17.4) (muted after 'broadcast')
distant_fair_generator.prompt: A diesel generator chugging in the distance.

distant_fair_motif.purpose: fair positional one-shot when player within 10 tiles of (25.6, 30.1) (muted after 'broadcast')
distant_fair_motif.prompt: A broken calliope playing a few wobbly notes far away.

distant_fair_pa.purpose: fair positional one-shot when player within 10 tiles of (22.65, 10.55) (only within 5 tiles + line of sight, before 'broadcast'; shows PA caption 3.5s)
distant_fair_pa.prompt: A distorted fairground loudspeaker crackling with garbled speech far away.

distant_fair_rattle.purpose: fair positional one-shot when player within 10 tiles of (17.2, 24.0)
distant_fair_rattle.prompt: A rickety ride chain rattling in the distance.

distant_mill_pump.purpose: sawmill positional one-shot when player within 10 tiles of (25.2, 8.3) (muted after 'relay')
distant_mill_pump.prompt: A water pump thumping rhythmically in the distance.

distant_mill_timber.purpose: sawmill positional one-shot when player within 10 tiles of (13.4, 23.5)
distant_mill_timber.prompt: A big log rolling and crashing onto a pile far away.

distant_quarry_bottler.purpose: quarry positional one-shot when player within 10 tiles of (27.7, 11.02) (muted after 'bottling')
distant_quarry_bottler.prompt: Glass bottles clinking along a machine far away.

distant_quarry_pipe.purpose: quarry positional one-shot when player within 10 tiles of (35.1, 23.1) (muted after 'bottling')
distant_quarry_pipe.prompt: A steam pipe groaning and knocking in the distance.

menu_move.purpose: menu cursor/page/option change; reading a wall note
menu_move.prompt: One tiny wooden tick, like a guitar pick tapping a fretboard.

menu_accept.purpose: menu accept/save/load/unlock notices; gallery start and win; hub clue read; default station cue; jukebox toggled (positional)
menu_accept.prompt: A short twangy guitar string pluck with a cash-drawer clunk.

menu_back.prompt: A short low muted guitar string thunk, falling.

empty.purpose: denied action: locked gate/door, blast-only panel, station prerequisites missing, locked replay level
empty.prompt: A dull rattle of a locked door handle: short denied clunk.

shakedown_intro.prompt: A menacing low twang guitar slide into a hard drum hit: boss arrival sting.

shakedown_end.prompt: A triumphant twangy guitar lick ending on a big ringing chord: boss defeated sting.

rudy_intro.purpose: shutdown station used, finale wave with rudy wakes (sting channel)
rudy_intro.prompt: A crooked carnival organ run crashing into a rockabilly guitar stab: boss arrival sting.

rudy_end.prompt: A rockabilly guitar flourish with a comic slide-whistle fall and final chord.

foreman_intro.purpose: shutdown station used, finale wave with foreman wakes (sting channel)
foreman_intro.prompt: A heavy blues guitar riff with an anvil clang: boss arrival sting.

foreman_end.prompt: A heavy blues guitar lick resolving on a big ringing chord with a final drum crash.

baron_intro.purpose: shutdown station used, finale wave with baron wakes (sting channel)
baron_intro.prompt: A dark Southern rock riff with a steam whistle and pounding toms: final boss arrival sting.

baron_end.prompt: A huge victorious Southern rock final chord with a rolling drum fill.

got_bessie.purpose: Bessie freed: Hickston level won (plays as effect with victory jingle)
got_bessie.prompt: A happy pig oinks and squeals with delight.

jerry_intro.purpose: Alien Sheriff dies and Jerry Jones wakes (played as effect, not sting)
jerry_intro.prompt: A marching-band drumline roll and a rude trombone blat.

jukebox.purpose: Hickston jukebox on and player within 11 tiles (radio channel, ducks music)
jukebox.prompt: An old honky-tonk country shuffle playing from a small jukebox speaker: twangy guitar, walking bass, brushed drums, tinny and warm. Instrumental.
